name: pulsating-button
blurb: Background expands and fades in a pulse loop.
description: A button with a background that expands outward and fades using scale and opacity animation on loop.
use_when: You want a subtle, eye-catching pulse effect on a prominent CTA.
avoid_when: When animation should be minimal or responsive to interaction only.
a11y: Standard button semantics. Pulse is visual only. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
